other_conditions: Minimum land ownership of one acre (or family account holder)
Must have a special interest in natural farming
Must be selected by the Regional Assistant Agriculture Officer or Agriculture Supervisor
Horticulture crops and animal husbandry should be included in natural farming
Priority is given to SC, ST, BPL, small and marginal farmers
Youth up to 35 years are eligible
Farmers already selected under Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana are excluded
Eligible farmers may be from the same village or neighboring villages
benefits_summary: Eligible farmers receive a 50% subsidy on inputs (up to Rs.600 per farmer) along with equipment such as drums, buckets, and training support.
